_readme: Copy this file to ~/Library/Application Support/Voice-to-Text/config.json and edit. Everything is optional — with no config file at all, the backend transcribes on the local Parakeet-MLX server (server/parakeet_server.py). Restart the backend (pm2 restart voice-to-text-backend) after editing.

remote._readme: Route transcription to a remote box instead of the local Parakeet server. Set 'parakeet' to any endpoint that accepts a raw-WAV POST and returns {text}. Omit or leave empty to stay fully local.
